import pytest


def test_login_ok(record_property):
    record_property("qa-assert", "A-1")
    assert True


def test_total_is_correct(record_property):
    record_property("qa-assert", "A-2")
    record_property("qa-assert", "A-3")
    assert 1 + 1 == 2


def test_banner_text(record_property):
    record_property("qa-assert", "A-4")
    assert "Welcome" == "Welcome back"


def test_untagged_pass():
    assert True


@pytest.fixture
def broken():
    raise RuntimeError("fixture exploded")


def test_error_in_fixture(broken):
    pass


@pytest.mark.skip(reason="not on this platform")
def test_skipped(record_property):
    record_property("qa-assert", "A-5")


@pytest.mark.xfail(reason="known bug")
def test_expected_failure():
    assert False


class TestGroup:
    def test_inside_class(self, record_property):
        record_property("qa-assert", "A-6")
        assert True
